Join Combat Air-racing and get your name in the rankings!

notes.title: Wing Breakers Full Release Coming March 10th, Supporting 10 Languages Now!
notes.content:
Hello guys,

We are super excited to tell you that [b]Wing Breakers full release is coming on March 10th[/b], finally leaving Early Access!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/V5iz70J.gif[/img]

If you are new to Wing Breakers, don’t forget to [u][b]add the game to your wishlist[/b][/u], so you won’t miss the release date.

Thanks goes to all players who were helping us with bug reports and new features.
Throughout recent beta testing, Wing Breakers has been polished and some final goodies are still on the way.

The big feature in this update is language support - [b]Wing Breakers supports 10 languages now![/b]

We cannot wait to see you guys playing Wing Breakers all around the globe.
And if English is not your strong point, we hope that this update can help you progress through the game easier.

The following languages are now supported:
[list]
[*]English
[*]Simplified Chinese
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Italian
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Brazilian Portuguese
[*]Russian
[*]Spanish
[/list]

If you find some translation mistakes, please let us know. You can use ingame 'Bugs & Ideas' message box or visit Wing Breakers on Discord. https://discord.gg/7HQGAa5Scq

Your feedback and suggestions are greatly appreciated as always!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6536680/2d7948622499086221856790793c8a6c853e3ce4.jpg[/img]

Cheers,
The Gugila team

notes.title: Wing Breakers - Destroying Bugs and Drones
notes.content:
Hello guys,

This update is focused on feature improvements and important bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6536680/cc92dafedd685701e06d8efde5dfd33d480830a9.jpg[/img]

Here's the list:

- Aerobatics and shooting during race delivers more damage fix (15% more)
- MP: 
[list]
[*]Increased multiplayer network buffer sizes, to make game less jerky for far away (big ping) connections.
[*]Plane picking includes new plane Storm Pusher, if you opened it in campaign mode.
[*]Fixed player name on hangar door and flag in hangar (sometimes cut).
[*]Bots adjusted to better fit all players (bots are now all different experience levels).
[*]Improved track selection for voting. Voting randomly picks 1 short and 1 long track so selection is more varied.
[/list]
- Time Attack:
[list]
[*]"Add to my picks" bug fixed.
[*]Replay practice mode crashing bug fixed.
[*]Featured user tracks for beginners are easier than for experienced players.
[*]New players must finish the first level of campaign to play all user tracks.
[/list]
- Hangar fixes:
[list]
[*]Chrome parts colours were too bright (especially gold).
[*]It is displayed in hangar how many bullets/missiles plane can carry.
[*]Game shows if an item is already used to avoid removing it from other planes.
[/list]
- Adjusted default sensitivity and alignment speed for controls, especially mouse.
- In the showcase after race is over, attached toy could be misplaced.
- Tutorial includes picking controls (default or inverted).
- Intro sequence cleaned up.

- Track editor crashing bug fixed
- Track editor: after playtesting, go back to editor menu not main menu.


Another thing we are testing is live race streaming. This Friday MP event will be LIVE streamed. Join the event or watch the live streaming. You can find Wing Breakers live stream on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/308080]store page[/url] or Youtube.
BTW. We are no streamers, we are testing Wing Breaker streaming. Please go easy on us. ;)

[b]As full release is coming soon[/b], we are still fixing minor problems while polishing Wing Breakers. 
Language localization is also coming soon. We will set language channels on our Discord to talk about translation. 
Feel free to share your feedback and ideas that will help us finalize the game:
Join Wing Breakers Discord: https://discord.com/invite/Xm8eq8AXMU

Cheers,
The Gugila team

notes.title: Plane 'Ghost Duster' and New License Track
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pmRRhbV.gif[/img]

New plane is finally here. After considering player feedback* and some more brainstorming, we decided to call it '[b]Ghost Duster[/b]'.
Most planes were also tuned and hopefully got more character. 
'Ghost Duster' should be better for longer races while Bullet-AX can now handle high speed and straight races better than other planes (and live up to its name). 
T-Force also got a new skinless look, probably a bit silly. Just remove skin from T-Force to check it out.

Also a new license track called '[b]Blow Up Run[/b]' is here, waiting for best times to be set.

Smaller improvements and fixes:
[list]
[*]New license for beginners - 'A0 Talent'. Also it comes with new achievements that existing players should also complete.
[*]Moccies reappear in MP (extra fun this way).
[*]Tutorial tracks got some new objects.
[*]Some license track icons were replaced for better looks. Tracks didn't change so no records were reset or lost.
[*]Available achievement shows up at the start of the race to make race goal more obvious.
[*]Cosmetic menu fixes.
[/list]

* Special thanks goes to HellfiresGhost for a plane name idea.

As usual join multiplayer live events every Friday.
2 time slots: 20h CET (Europe) and 20h EST (Americas).

notes.title: Tune Controls For Better Ride
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6536680/67e158c470b97ee72722c13a6d450621ce739ee5.jpg[/img]

This update brings updated plane controls.

Players these days are using different controllers to play Altitude0: 
[b]XBox 360/One, mouse, keyboard, Steam controller, flight sticks and more.[/b]

We did a major revamp of controls and added many customizable settings:
[list]
[*]New controls mapping page, you can now also adjust controls during solo race by pressing pause button.
[*]For gamepads and flight sticks we added sensitivity controls - left/right and up/down settings can be tuned separately.
[*]If you play with mouse, you can adjust horizontal and vertical sensitivity separately.
[*]Steam controller received a separate tuning page for sensitivity, dead zone and rudder settings.
[*]Standard controls now have extra rudder controls. Although standard controls use automatic rudder, some players desired this extra control. 
[/list]

Old controller settings had to be reset. 
[b]If you adjusted controls in the past, you will have to do it again.[/b] 
It shouldn't take much time and you get more settings to tweak this time.

And join multiplayer live events every Friday.
2 time slots: 20h CET (Europe) and 20h EST (Americas).

notes.title: Aim for the Hole - Track Editor Updated!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4f3HOiD.gif[/img]

[b]Track editor[/b] receives a major update with extra objects and new ways to make your tracks exciting and fun. 
Buildings like hangars, warehouse and barns can be used to [b]fly through[/b]. This should make for some fun tight competitions in multiplayer.
From now on we will be using track editor ourselves to build new tracks. That means that editor will be updated regularly as we add new stuff.

New editor features:
[list]
[*] Extra objects: ruins, barns, hangars, silo, warehouse, wind turbines, blimps and windmills.
[*] Race path displayed between gates makes it easier to check that gates are in order.
[*] New replay cameras:  static, zoom, parallel fly-by and multiple plane cameras are in.
[*] Multiple undo / redo, saving view positions for better workflow added.
[*] Flatten button will flatten terrain around buildings.
[*] Roads are now displayed in editor, this makes it easier to place objects like buildings around them.
[/list]

Build and share your ideal tracks with the new track editor. 
Editor runs in WebGL compatible web-browser, you can get it here: http://www.altitude0.com/a0editor

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6536680/228238cd2afa4427588af7b169a6ee18fe5ef265.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6536680/a36465fddd113621f44fd320b4b2c1f985bbab40.jpg[/img]


And some game improvements:
[list]
[*] License track 'Plane Invasion' was added (made with the new editor).
[*] New type of 'must pass' gate with a red ring is in. This gate must be flown through without skipping.
[*] All license races now have 8 planes participating.
[/list]

And join multiplayer live events every Friday.
2 time slots: 20h CET (Europe) and 20h EST (Americas).

notes.content:

Hi guys, 
A long awaited [b]plane customization[/b] update is here! 
Play solo or multiplayer modes and collect plane parts: propellers, winglets, spikes, fins and many more. 
You can get parts for the plane you are using by collecting racing points - more racing points means more parts. Once you collect all parts for a plane you can start collecting different color sets: chrome, green, bronze and more.

notes.title: Mayhem Tracks full of Machines & Obstacles - new Altitude0 Track Editor
notes.content:
[img]http://www.altitude0.com/shared/images/a0_news_trackeditorupdate.jpg[/img]

Altitude0 track editor is now fully equipped with different obstacles and machines. 
Fire rings, swinging blades or crane wrecking balls? You can decide which machines to use to make your tracks more exciting.  
Track creators can now also place a huge number of crashable obstacles like haystacks, barrels and logs. 

Here is a list of track editor additions:
[list]
[*][b]Machines[/b]: compressing bats (up and down, left and right), swinging blades, huge fans, fire rings, wrecking balls and gate doors.
[*]Setup [b]time offset[/b] (delay) on machines to allow them to move at different times.
[*][b]Obstacles[/b]: different stacks of barrels, logs and hay stacks - or create your own combinations.
[*][b]Billboards[/b]: two types of ad boards -> you can add your own message. 
[*][b]Race rules[/b]: you can set up race rules like altitude limit and aerobatic points. Also set up track difficulty.
[*]Shortruns: low flying and spin aerobatics can be set up.
[*]Forest Cutters: set up where to clear forest for placing objects. 
[*]Button added to do local or world movement.
[*]More rocks added to the mountain scene. 
[/list]

Other fixes and improvements:
[list]
[*]Plane vapor fixed: it's now emitted properly, only when Gforces are big.
[*]Plane collisions were improved in multiplayer - collisions are now less fatal.
[*]Canyon and Alps scenes were optimized, both now use less memory.
[/list]
